component.name: simple-capture
component.summary: Record your screen, camera and voice, then edit and export

description.p: simple-capture is a screen recorder with a small video editor built in. Record a display or a window with your camera in a corner and your microphone and system audio on their own tracks. Before you record, pick a frame shape to match where the video is going, from 16:9 down to vertical 9:16 for short-form video.
When you stop, the editor opens. Trim and split clips, speed them up, blur anything private, and add text with outlines, shadows and simple animations.
Export to MP4, MOV, WebM, GIF or animated WebP, with presets for email, team chat, video sites and vertical video, and a size estimate before the export starts.
You don't need an account, and the app never connects to the internet. Recordings stay on your computer.
First Linux release (experimental): GNOME and KDE Plasma on Wayland.
